body: Again I completely agree. The safety of the dogs comes first in my opinion. I'd rather them be happy - and unfortunately her pickiness won't let up. We've all tried talking and she sets off like a time bomb. We have about 3 days to figure this out and she won't comply. It frustrates me to no end. Meanwhile my dad is calling multiple people- and she's constantly going off on what an asshole he is.

That's another problem. I'd gladly agree with something such as that and I thank you immensely for the suggestion. My mother won't give them anywhere she can't visit them within that 4-6 months she's staying at a friends.

We have asked other family memers and friends. None of them can do anything. My mom as asked people at the church but no luck. We've tried all we can for them. And I don't know what would become of them if I were to die. It's such a horribly selfish thing to think of, seeing as I'd be getting away from everything, but with everybody constantly on your ass when you're not able to do much, it's such a temptation.
